name: agent-enables-trusted-posture
description: An otherwise canonical run in which the agent turns the Trusted posture on for the owner instead of preparing the review and handing it over. The posture commands are owner-only and human-only: agents recommend, humans decide. Declared as forbidden_step and NOT as unknown_step on purpose — an unrecognised id is a typo, an id matching the forbidden patterns is an authority violation, and deleting the trusted_beta patterns must turn this fixture red rather than leave it green on the typo error.
